article.title: BigCommerce為合資格商戶推出店內購物助手
article.summary: Commerce.com公布Shopping Agent開始向合資格BigCommerce商戶推出，讓消費者在店內以對話找商品及比較。
highlights: 助手可延續追問、協助加入購物車和引導結帳。
獨立的對話式店內搜尋已供所有付費方案使用。
article.why: 電商團隊可分開檢視商品查詢、加購與結帳，確認顧客在哪一步需要人員協助。
article.next_step: 選一個品類，以用途、尺寸及預算測試查詢，再逐一核對推薦及購物車結果。
article.detail: Commerce.com表示，商戶可調整助手的外觀及品牌呈現，讓顧客在店內問商品、比較選項及加入購物車。Shopping Agent現階段限合資格商戶，對話式搜尋的付費方案範圍則另行列明。團隊可用有多個型號的商品測試，確認追問後顯示的選項仍符合原先條件。
article.title_en: BigCommerce starts rolling out a storefront shopping agent to eligible merchants
article.summary_en: Commerce.com announced the rollout of Shopping Agent to eligible BigCommerce merchants for product discovery and comparison in conversation.
highlights_en: The agent can handle follow-up questions, help add items to the cart and guide checkout.
Separate conversational storefront search is available on all paid plans.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can assess discovery, cart and checkout separately and identify where shoppers need staff support.
article.next_step_en: Test searches in one category by use, size and budget, then reconcile recommendations and cart items.
article.detail_en: Commerce.com says merchants can customize the assistant's presentation and help shoppers compare items and add them to the cart. Shopping Agent currently serves eligible merchants, while the conversational search feature has separate paid-plan availability. Test products with several variants and check that choices still meet the original criteria after follow-up questions.
